title: Emergence of high-mass stars in complex fiber networks (EMERGE). II. The need for data combination in ALMA observations
question: How strongly do interferometric filtering and the missing short-spacing information bias the recovered flux, peak, FWHM and radial profile of simulated cores and filaments in ALMA continuum data, and how much do 12m+7m, Feather, MACF and 12m+IRAM-30m combinations fix it?

data.arrays: ALMA 12m, ACA-7m and Total Power simulated separately
data.angular_resolution: 12m C43-1: 3.38 arcsec; ACA-7m: 12.5 arcsec; TP: 62.9 arcsec (at 100 GHz, from the Technical Handbook)
data.sensitivity: noisy runs use tsys-atm thermal noise with PWV = 1.8 mm (Band 3); most runs noise-free

what.value: ALMA Cycle 10 Technical Handbook values for resolution and MRS of 12m, 7m and TP

evidence.quote: All the values listed here are taken from the

what.value: dust emissivity frequency dependence beta=1.6 typical for Orion filaments and cores

evidence.quote: typical for filaments and cores in Orion (cite: Sadavoy2016; Mason2020)

what.value: OMC-3 data reduction, imaging and combination products (12m + IRAM-30m Feather and MACF)

evidence.quote: The observations, the data reduction and imaging procedures, and the data combination technique used are presented in (cite: 2024Hacar).

what.value: identification of the 23 small-scale filaments (fibers) in OMC-3

recipe.goal: quantify use of data combination in ALMA archive
recipe.method: Query ALMA Science Archive with ALminer for ISM mosaic GOUS in Cycles 6-9 and count 12m, 7m and TP requests per year
assumptions: selecting mosaics implies extended emission larger than the primary beam and so beyond the MRS

recipe.method: Generate noise-free model images of Gaussian cores, infinite Gaussian filaments, finite elongated Gaussians and Plummer-like filaments, scaled to a fixed peak intensity
key_parameters: FWHM = 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 70 arcsec for Gaussian cores and filaments
finite filaments: FWHM fixed at 15 arcsec, length varied to give aspect ratios from 1 to infinity
assumptions: dust emissivity k_nu = 0.01 cm2/g at 300 GHz, i.e. 0.002 cm2/g at 100 GHz, with beta = 1.6
mean molecular weight mu_H2 = 2.8 and constant Tdust = 15 K (T = 10 K for the CMF test)

recipe.method: Run simobserve on the model image with hexagonal Nyquist mosaics: 12m 67 pointings over 3.5 arcmin, 2 x 30 s per pointing; 7m 33 pointings over 4.5 arcmin, 30 s x 14 repetitions over 3 days
key_parameters: thermalnoise = tsys-atm for the noisy runs, PWV = 1.8 mm
assumptions: integration time ratio C43-1 : ACA-7m = 1 : 7 to match sensitivities

recipe.method: tclean in mfs mode with Briggs robust 0.5, cleaning threshold from a dirty image, impbcor at cutoff 0.85, then imsmooth to a symmetric beam
key_parameters: cleaning threshold = 10% of the dirty-image emission peak, niter = 1e8
pixel 0.5 arcsec (12m), 2 arcsec (7m); final beams 4.5 and 16 arcsec

recipe.method: Convolve the model image with imsmooth to 62.9 arcsec (ALMA TP) or 25 arcsec (IRAM-30m at 100 GHz); add radiometer-equation noise for noisy SD runs
key_parameters: TP resolution 62.9 arcsec; IRAM-30m resolution 25 arcsec

recipe.method: 12m+7m via concat then joint tclean; add TP with CASA feather (sdfactor 1.0) or MACF; replace 7m+TP by an IRAM-30m image with MACF for the large-SD test

recipe.goal: measure recovered flux, peak and FWHM
recipe.method: Extract a radial profile from a cut along the x axis of each image, integrate it for total flux, fit a Gaussian for peak and FWHM, and compare with the input model and the beam-convolved expected FWHM
key_parameters: expected observed FWHM = input FWHM convolved with the beam in quadrature

recipe.method: Compare u-v coverage and PSF images and radial cuts of 12m, 7m and 12m+7m simulations against an ideal Gaussian PSF

recipe.goal: test sensitivity requirement of SD data
recipe.method: Compute the SD to interferometer integration time ratio from the Mason and Brogan formula, simulate IRAM-30m noise at 1, 5 and 10 times the prediction for a FWHM = 30 arcsec core and combine with MACF
key_parameters: tau_SD about 4 tau_int for 12m C43-1 in Cycle 9 and IRAM-30m
assumptions: same spectral setup, antenna efficiencies and system temperature

recipe.goal: compare with real OMC-3 ALMA data
recipe.method: Extract radial cuts perpendicular to each of 23 fibers in 12m-alone, 12m+IRAM-30m Feather and MACF images and compare flux, peak and FWHM normalised to the 12m+IRAM-30m MACF reference with the simulation trends
assumptions: 12m + IRAM-30m MACF map taken as the true emission distribution

recipe.goal: test bias on the core mass function
recipe.method: Draw 500 core masses with Salpeter-like slope 1.35 in 0.5-10 Msun, assign FWHM uniformly in 5-30 arcsec, convert to column density and flux, simulate ALMA 12m, 7m and TP, then extract peak, FWHM and mass for the recovered CMF
key_parameters: homogeneous dust temperature T = 10 K; D = 414 pc

tclean gridder (mosaic), imsize per array, deconvolver and whether multiscale or any mask was used
how the model image units (mJy/pix, 0.25 arcsec pixel) were converted to Jy/pixel at the clean pixel scales
how the 12m (3.5 arcmin) and 7m (4.5 arcmin) mosaics map onto the 6.25 arcmin field, and the primary-beam cutoff handling at mosaic edges for the profile cuts
how the flux fraction was integrated (aperture, cut length, treatment of negative sidelobes) and the Gaussian-fit routine, initial guesses and fit window
where along the image the radial cut was taken for filaments and elongated cores, and whether cuts were averaged
random seed and number of noise realisations for the noisy runs
how the Feather and MACF products were scaled for SD flux calibration beyond sdfactor = 1.0, and the startmodel scaling in MACF
the TP simulation beyond imsmooth to 62.9 arcsec (no TP-specific simobserve setup is given)
CMF sample: core positions in the field, the mass estimator used on recovered cores and the core-finding method
OMC-3 real data: fiber identification list, radial-cut spacing and length, fitting procedure and the exact IRAM-30m/ALMA reduction parameters (all deferred to Paper I and Paper III)
missing_for_reproduction: Antenna configuration files, imsize, gridder and deconvolver settings for tclean
Profile cut definition, flux integration and fitting details

score_reason: On a 1-5 scale: the simulation chain (CASA 6.5.2, array setups, imaging and combination parameters) is given in good detail, but several tclean and measurement settings are missing and the real-data part depends on other papers.
rediscovery_reason: The core results come from synthetic observations that need no archive data and have numeric answers; the real OMC-3 part depends on Paper I processing.
